critical_code_review_comments: BUG FIXED: TeacherRemarks.jsx was calling API without trailing slashes (/remarks instead of /remarks/). FastAPI redirects to trailing slash version, but the redirect was causing Mixed Content (HTTP->HTTPS) errors. Fixed by adding trailing slashes to api.post('/remarks/') and api.get('/remarks/').
Backend remarks.py correctly implements role-based access: Teachers see own remarks, Management sees all
Backend correctly handles multi-role users via user_roles set intersection with MANAGEMENT_ROLES
Frontend correctly hides stats dashboard and status controls for non-management users
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing

bug_fix_details.original_issue: Frontend API calls to /api/remarks were failing with Mixed Content errors (HTTP instead of HTTPS)
bug_fix_details.root_cause: FastAPI auto-redirects /api/remarks to /api/remarks/ (trailing slash). The redirect was somehow causing the browser to use HTTP instead of HTTPS, triggering Mixed Content blocking.
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Added trailing slashes to API calls in TeacherRemarks.jsx: api.post('/remarks/') and api.get('/remarks/')
